segments.ja348:1.3: Purisaṃ tāta seveyyaṃ, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja348:2.1: Yo taṃ vissāsaye tāta, vissāsañca khameyya te;
segments.ja348:2.3: Sussūsī ca titikkhī ca, taṃ bhajehi ito [taṃ bhajeyyāsito (ka.)] gato.
segments.ja348:3.1: Yassa kāyena vācāya, manasā natthi dukkaṭaṃ;
segments.ja348:3.3: Urasīva patiṭṭhāya, taṃ bhajehi ito gato.
segments.ja348:4.3: Tādisaṃ tāta mā sevi, nimmanussampi ce siyāti.
